title: site alert dont stack dont panic
rule: One full-width site alert near the top. Do not stack. Multiple messages = a list of links inside a single site alert. Positioning already gives weight; do not use heavy red/orange panic colour. Dual-cite GOV.UK notification banner and System status: sitewide static, never form validation, never stacked.
pass_when: At most one sitewide static site alert; extra messages are links inside it; not used for form/task validation; colour is not panic-red/orange as the only weight.
fail_when: Stacked site alerts; site alert used as field/page form validation; or panic colour as the only signal.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Page alert type-word (`uswds.alert-first-word-is-type`); live system-status toasts.
